task_input: The shell argument formatting functions accept a sep parameter, but custom separators are ignored. Repair args2sh, args2cmd, and the escape_shell_args wrapper's behavior so the requested separator is used while preserving default spacing and existing escaping and quoting behavior. Only boltons/strutils.py may be changed.
